name: The Peninsula Istanbul
positioning: Waterfront hotel on the Bosphorus in Karaköy, within the Galataport project, set across four buildings, three of them historic and restored
best_for: Travelers who want a Bosphorus waterfront base in Karaköy
Guests interested in restored heritage buildings and Turkish art
Families, with a Camp Peninsula tent and Peninsula Academy programs for children

facts.text: The hotel is set along the Bosphorus waterfront in the historic district of Karaköy.
The hotel is within Galataport, a new waterfront revitalisation project.
The hotel is made up of four buildings, three of them historic and restored.
Two of the buildings date from the early 20th century, one is a 1930s Bauhaus building and one is a new glass build, joined by corridors of Marmara marble.
The Galata Tower stands behind the hotel.
Rooms and suites across the four waterfront buildings pair modern Turkish design with gardens, terraces and Bosphorus views.
Room headboards are inspired by the ochre stone blocks of Divriği Mosque in Anatolia.
The Lobby is an all-day dining venue with Bosphorus views, serving Mediterranean dishes from morning to evening.
The Lobby serves daily Peninsula Afternoon Tea and Sunday Brunch, both of which can be enjoyed on the outdoor terrace with live music.
The Peninsula Spa occupies a marble-clad lower-level space in the hotel's main building.
The spa has a white hammam inlaid with mother-of-pearl.
Children are given a complimentary Camp Peninsula tent with treats.

highlights.text: Guests arrive at what was the former port's passport office.
The rooftop restaurant Gallada's menu takes diners along the Silk Road, using Turkish ingredients and Chinese cooking techniques.
The hotel has an outdoor swimming pool right along the Bosphorus waterfront and an indoor pool surrounded by Marmara columns under illuminated domes.
The Peninsula Suite's private rooftop, with views over the Bosphorus and Galata Tower, has a private pool area and a glass-house solarium for dining and lounging.
The Art Suite is adorned with original paintings, drawings, photographs and sculptures by contemporary and classical Turkish artists.

considerations.text: The hotel is 45 km from the airport.
WhataHotel notes premium luxury pricing reflecting the hotel's high-end positioning.
